hits.text:
Harbour District plan › notes › kit
- Kit adopt / reject (brief 007 A replaces the 006 B note; 007 lifts 'the kit fits the plan, never the other way' for the skyline).
- ADOPT SpaceHQ: signatures.space-hq, the dominant icon at Crown Circus east, 252 m; regen SpaceHQ_Portal (terminal drum r 40 to 34 with S1 and Crown Circus station inside; shaft −29 m, tip kept).
- ADOPT Tower_Starburst: towers.sites avenue-starburst, the tallest rival, tiers cut to the 3.6 grid, tip 194.3.
- ADOPT Tower_Needle: towers.sites avenue-needle, saucer floor to storey 30 (100.8 over the deck), tip 167.8.
- ADOPT DiscTower ×2: towers.sites avenue-gate-w / -e, 88 m apart across Crown Avenue, shaft to the grid (111.6), tip 165.6.
- ADOPT SkyBridge: towers.skyBridges avenue-gate, as built (70 m clear between the DiscTowers), floor 67.03.
- ADOPT Tower_Terrace: towers.sites crescent-terrace, terraces to the grid, tip 122.7.
- ADOPT Skylon: landmarks.skylon in Starline Green, × 0.925, top 100.
- ADOPT LinerDock: landmarks.liner-berth, a caisson 20 m off the Market Docks crane walk; regen at × 0.5 (tip 102.6 ≤ 104) so the Skyport Tower stays the harbour's icon; caisson only until then.
- ADOPT SkyRailStation_Twin (Vela, brief 007 C): the four S1 stations; inside SpaceHQ and the Skyport Tower as platform decks only.
- KEEP SphereStation (landmarks.sphere × 0.425), Skyport_Tower_Portal (skyport-tower), CircusMonument, ParabolicArch (skyport-tower.gateway), SkyPad_Roof (pad, hover-pad roofs).
- KEEP the 006 B regen sites: parade-gate-n / -s Tower_Stepped, harbour-hotel Tower_Saucer, crescent-tower Tower_Atom, lantern-beacon Tower_Lantern.
- REJECT Tower_Setback (172 m, 30 m plan): no crown of its own, and grammar §6 already crowns every ≥ 9-storey block; a sixth rival would crowd the cluster under rivalMax.
- REJECT SkyRailStation (single beam, rail top 22, 40 m platforms): superseded by SkyRailStation_Twin.
- Rule changes these sites need (signature ground, portals, skyline, platform clearance) are handed to Splice: see the brief 007 A report.

tag: [S]
rule: brief 007 (Sky 2026-10-13): one dominant icon, a cluster of rival spires, crowns everywhere. The plan makes sites for the signature structures (signatures[], towers.sites, landmarks); scale, levels, clearances and the checker still rule how they stand
dominant: {"id":"space-hq","tip":252,"why":"SpaceHQ as built (kit 252.0 tall): the tallest thing in the district (Sky 2026-10-13); every other tip stays under rivalMax"}
rivalMax: 200
rivalMaxWhy: ≤ 0.8 × dominant (201.6), rounded down: the dominant stays at least a quarter taller than its tallest rival, as SpaceHQ over the needle trio in Blocks/needle_trio.png and mixed_skyline.png. The rival cluster sits 0.45–0.8 of the dominant
harbour: {"icon":"skyport-tower","tip":108,"within":150,"why":"the Skyport Tower stays the harbour's icon (brief 007 Fixed): nothing standing within 150 m of the quay edge (x 312) tops 108; the rival spires stand inland, north of Crown Circus"}
tiers: dominant 252: space-hq (signatures), rival spires 120–200: avenue-starburst 194.3, avenue-needle 167.8, avenue-gate-w / -e 165.6 (DiscTower pair + SkyBridge), crescent-terrace 122.7, harbour icon 108: skyport-tower; under it on the water liner-berth 103.7 (its terminal tower) and the ocean-liner 34.0 alongside, and the harbour front (harbour-hotel 106, crescent-tower 99.4, parade gates 75), marks 80–106: skylon 100, sphere 80, lantern-beacon 86.1, street wall 20–50: H(4)–H(12), every building ≥ 9 storeys crowned (grammar §6)
crowns: every tower and signature names its crown: the signature pieces keep their own (SpaceHQ atom over a needle mast; Tower_Needle needle and saucers; Tower_Starburst starburst; DiscTower disc, jib and mast; Tower_Terrace belvedere finial; Skylon spindle); tower sites take the grammar §6 catalogue (contracts/world/harbour-district.grammar.md); within 150 m no two towers share a crown type, matched pairs excepted
